steps.en: A daily report is generated automatically every day
steps.id: Laporan harian dibuat otomatis setiap hari

steps.en: The report lists notices updated as paid on that day
steps.id: Laporan memuat notice yang diperbarui sebagai dibayar pada hari itu
steps.why_en: Selection follows the suspension date, so backdated manual payments are missed and only the latest payment per notice is kept.
steps.why_id: Pemilihan mengikuti tanggal suspension, jadi pembayaran manual tanggal mundur terlewat dan hanya pembayaran terakhir per notice yang dipakai.

steps.en: The report is an Excel file with a summary and payment details per channel
steps.id: Laporan berupa file Excel berisi ringkasan dan detail pembayaran per channel

steps.en: The report also includes any errors that happened while updating paid status
steps.id: Laporan juga memuat error (jika ada) saat status bayar diperbarui
steps.why_en: Errors only go to the system log; a separate exception report lists payment exceptions, not processing errors.
steps.why_id: Error hanya masuk log sistem; laporan exception terpisah memuat pengecualian pembayaran, bukan error proses.

steps.en: The report is emailed to officers as an Excel file they can download
steps.id: Laporan dikirim ke petugas lewat email sebagai file Excel yang bisa di-download
